result.summary: Documents in the libbitcoinkernel C header that calling btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks while an import is already in progress on the same chainstate manager triggers a process abort. It adds a doc comment warning callers against concurrent invocations.
result.problem: Consumers of the libbitcoinkernel C API are not informed by the header that concurrent calls to btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks on the same chainstate manager will hit an assertion in ImportingNow and abort the process.
evidence: "A second btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks call on the same chainstate manager, while one is in progress, aborts the process, and the kernel header does not say so." (PR description)
result.changed_since_previous: Narrowed from documenting three separate API behaviors and abort conditions down to only the concurrent import_blocks abort warning.
result.card: Documents in bitcoinkernel.h that invoking btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks while another import is in progress on the same chainstate manager aborts the process. Without this documentation, consumers of the kernel C API might inadvertently trigger fatal process aborts during concurrent operations. The pull request is documentation-only, adding four comment lines to the kernel public header.

risk.why: Documentation-only comment addition in a header file.
